name: Product design company
purpose: Develop a technical product concept through practical user needs, feasibility evidence, and prototype evaluation.

roles.name: Product lead
roles.purpose: Own the target outcome, priorities, and business constraints.
decisions: Frame the opportunity within the user's goal

roles.name: Research team
roles.purpose: Investigate user needs and distinguish observation from assumption.
decisions: Choose research questions and evidence methods

roles.name: Design lead
roles.purpose: Design technical product behavior, information flow, interaction, and prototype production.
decisions: Choose technical product alternatives with product and engineering input
Define functional behavior and interaction contracts

roles.name: Engineering lead
roles.purpose: Contribute technical possibilities, constraints, and feasibility findings early.
decisions: Recommend prototype fidelity and technical approaches

roles.name: Prototype team
roles.purpose: Build the smallest artifact that can test the concept's important assumptions.
decisions: Choose production details within the concept and test protocol

roles.name: Evaluation team
roles.purpose: Evaluate user value, usability, feasibility evidence, and remaining assumptions.
decisions: Identify what the prototype did and did not establish

roles.name: Evaluation recorder adapter
roles.purpose: Emit structured peer observations through the independent evaluator recorder; no separately running grading model is required.
decisions: Record observed peer contributions without inventing an independent verdict
Preserve uncertainty and de-identify examples before optional upload
Read contextual capability advice from the independent evaluator when available

interactions.contract: Use user evidence to develop and challenge design alternatives.
Explore user value and business viability together.
Explore experience and technical possibilities together.
Provide feasibility constraints and bounded technical support.
Check provenance and the limits of research claims.
Evaluate the prototype against its declared assumptions.
Supply comments about other models from shared task experience, with difficulty and concrete examples.
Supply comments about other models from shared task experience, with difficulty and concrete examples.
Supply comments about other models from shared task experience, with difficulty and concrete examples.
Supply comments about other models from shared task experience, with difficulty and concrete examples.
Supply contextual capability estimates, dissent, and advisory role-fit suggestions.

workflow.on_rejection: Record a finding, reopen the named rework stage as a new attempt, and invalidate affected downstream artifacts.

checks: Target users and outcomes are explicit
Assumptions are distinguished from supplied evidence
Each factual finding has a traceable real source; an empty evidence inventory supports hypothesis exploration only
Invented interviews or simulated users are not represented as observed evidence
Unresolved evidence gaps are explicit; missing user evidence blocks a scope that requires validated user needs
Material technical and production constraints have supporting evidence
Design alternatives and their tradeoffs are recorded
Important assumptions have a planned prototype check
Prototype supports the named evaluation tasks
Each important assumption has evidence or an explicit unresolved status
Aesthetic approval alone cannot establish usability or user value
A gate requiring user testing needs actual user evidence
Handover includes the design, evidence, constraints, and unresolved risks
